name: 359-woods
notes: #359 B3.b woods games: two kids at one real grown tree (BoxView.TreeSpots in the game). View/Beats/KidPlay2.cs WoodsGame: three rounds round the trunk (r 0.14): the 'it' bounces twice, both run round on opposite sides, the runner stops dead with a hand on the trunk (Contact on the tree: HitFx tree shake + 2 leaves), both peek round it (roll 20, step out 0.045), the runner dashes back the other way and the chaser cuts round: the tag (arm out, the runner jolts back), they swap. Then a stick duel beside the tree, 0.18 u apart: raise, strike (Contact when the sticks cross: a small flash of sparks), the other blocks and jolts back; 5-6 strikes, then both sticks held high (the end beat). AnimLab: cheat 'Kids play: woods' (needs a grown tree).
